description: This file defines types, constants, and includes for the HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) used in device settings, focusing on configuration options for audio, video, display, and platform settings within the device settings modules. It includes version macros and references to other type definitions but contains no executable code or definitions of functions, classes, or methods.

methods.name: dsHAL_APIVER
methods.description: Macro to generate a combined version number from major and minor version components.

methods.name: dsHAL_APIVER_MAJOR
methods.description: Macro to extract the major version from a combined version number.

methods.name: dsHAL_APIVER_MINOR
methods.description: Macro to extract the minor version from a combined version number.
